about: Shelburne is a town in Dufferin County, Ontario, at Highways 10 and 89 north of Orangeville—not Shelburne, Nova Scotia. A growing service town on the Dundalk Highlands fringe, it mixes a historic main street with new residential neighbourhoods. About 9,000 people live in Shelburne, Ontario.
